_comment: Role template for a READ-ONLY agent (tools: read-only). Used by the planner and
Write and Edit are DENIED, not merely discouraged. That is the point of the class:
- a planner decides what to do and structurally cannot do it
- a reviewer judges work and structurally cannot 'fix' what it finds, so it has to
write down what is wrong — which is what makes a review useful
The scope guard still applies to Read/Glob/Grep, so a read-only agent cannot read
outside its room either. Grep is guarded specifically because it returns matching
LINES: an unguarded Grep leaks file contents without ever writing (docs/SECURITY.md).
A planner needs to emit DELEGATE lines in its reply; that needs no tool, and the API
re-checks the authority policy on every task it creates.
Substitutions: {{HIVE_BIN}} = hive's bin dir on the AGENT's filesystem.
Generated by `hive provision` — do not hand-edit inside a room.
